choices.why: A long, low, clean-lined sofa in light beige linen on a dark wood plinth suits the calm Japandi look and fills the right wall well.
This 160x230 cm jute rug is a true natural fiber and is big enough to sit under both the sofa and the coffee table, warming the dark floor.
A plain round wood table on simple tapered legs is the most minimal, Japandi option and matches the sofa's dark wood base.
This tall white rice-paper floor lantern is exactly the paper lamp asked for and fits neatly in the corner beside the sofa.
The tall, leafy ZZ plant gives the corner by the balcony glass real presence while staying calm and green; it should be repotted in a ceramic pot as you asked.

answer.why: Beige linen, jute, warm wood and a white paper lantern keep a tight palette of neutrals and natural materials against the white walls and dark floor. Just a few calm pieces plus one green plant give you the serene, pared-back Japandi living room you described.
